request.answer: The previous hook was `onRequest`, the next hook will be `preValidation`. Notice: in the `preParsing` hook, request.body will always be null, because the body parsing happens before the `preValidation` hook. Notice: you should also add `receivedEncodedLength` property to the returned stream.
